Tests often use the same questions repeatedly. As an example, many of the Basic Skills test (20 questions) used the same two (2) questions for more than half the test. Effectively reducing the value of study to a limited subset. Test/practice questions never vary the order of answers, which effectively (mis)trains you to respond with the position of the right answer rather than paying attention to content… needless to say, the “real” test doesn’t work that way. You could well find yourself conditioned to select a response based on its sequence rather than content.

Complete Garbage Complete garbage. This app does not properly provide questions based on the state you select. I selected South Carolina, yet the app repeatedly gives questions that reference other states that I did not select.

I also found numerous questions where the answers appeared to be incorrect when compared with the official South Carolina CDL Manual. That makes this app especially frustrating when you’re using it to prepare for an actual CDL exam.

The “Exam” section is also terrible. It will literally ask the same question over and over—sometimes 5 times in a row—instead of giving you a useful variety of questions.

If you’re studying for a CDL, I would not rely on this app. The questions need to be properly matched to the selected state, the incorrect questions need to be fixed, and the exam section needs to stop recycling the same questions repeatedly.

The grammar needs cleaned up in several questions. While no developer probably has access to any state test bank there is a level at which some of these questions are worded to throw you off and that’s not the intent of state testing exams. They want to know if you understand the content of a specific subject, not if you have the mental capacity to unwind their twisted question to make sense of it, then answer the question. Pictures sometimes come up blurry with no real purpose related to the questions. The app has a great format and layout. Needs a button within each question so you can report problems with the question. IMO - I don’t feel it’s worth paying for beyond the free trial.
